a.lede: Waymo temporarily paused service in San Francisco after several robotaxis caused traffic jams as they were unable to navigate flooded streets during a storm.
a.title: Waymo pauses service in San Francisco after robotaxis get stuck on flooded streets

b.lede: Robotaxis already had to be recalled in May after they entered highway construction zones.
b.title: Waymo has stopped its robotaxis from driving on the freeway—here’s why
